parsed.headline: Claim denied: beneficiary did not meet BGM testing frequency requirement.
parsed.explanation: Coverage requires that 'The beneficiary has been using a BGM and performing frequent (four or more times a day) testing; and,' but the record shows only two tests per day. This does not meet the policy requirement for coverage.
